### Contract review brief — PR #38011 @ `b41c6ea0a9ae50397f8ea18a7c4c829446047b5d` (card #37862)

You review at `TIER_DEFAULT`. Render ONE `## Contract review` record on this head — its shape is
`node scripts/pm/record-recognisers.mjs --template --face declaration` — with a PASS or FAIL verdict, and post it as ONE comment
on the PR or its card.

Inputs — these and nothing else:
  · card #37862: its body and EVERY comment (rulings and earlier records included)
  · PR #38011: its body, its file list, and the net diff against `main` at `b41c6ea0a9ae50397f8ea18a7c4c829446047b5d`
  · the check-runs on `b41c6ea0a9ae50397f8ea18a7c4c829446047b5d`: their conclusions ARE the gate verdicts
⛔ Not the dispatch order, ⛔ not the dispatching seat's own conclusions — this brief is adversarial by design.

⛔ READ-ONLY. No worktree, no checkout, no build, no test run, no gate re-run, no ablation: the check-runs
   on the head already answered every derived gate family, and a local run costs more than it returns.
   If ONE probe is unavoidable, the record's `Local-runs:` line says `probe — REASON`; otherwise `none`.
   Scratch space is `SCRATCHPAD/pr-38011/` alone; nothing there you did not write this round is read.

Judge, in the record's own sections:
  ① Derived judgments — every accept-set and public-surface change the diff implies, each named right or wrong.
  ② Semver level — the changeset (or `skip-changeset`) matches what the diff publishes, and the `Clause-②:` line.
  ③ Boundary flags — every dev flag and every `open_questions` entry answered, or escalated.
     On every face, SQL push-down: a new id materialisation or in-app join where SQL could push down is a
     finding unless a reason is given (AGENTS.md, Prime Directive 5: SQL first).
Sign `Implemented-by:` with the dev's branch and `Reviewed-by:` with your session id — the value is the FIRST
thing after each colon.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `TIER_DEFAULT`
Head-sha: `b41c6ea0a9ae50397f8ea18a7c4c829446047b5d`
Local-runs: none

Read: card #37862 (body, claim 7221234060, os-dev-report 7222350321, claim amendment 7222366115), PR #38011 (body, 23-file list), the net diff `origin/main...b41c6ea0` (merge base `4de4e3e9`), and the check-runs on the head. The diff touches no `packages/spec`, no skill, no ADR and no other governed path, so the declaration face (`Clause-②: yes (widening)`) is the only one owed.

### ① Derived judgments

Every public-surface change in the diff, each checked against the declaration and the changeset:

- **`@object-ui/i18n` (published): nine new keys in all 11 packs. Named right.** `console.ai.suggestionsLabel` plus `console.ai.suggestions.page.{record.summarize, record.related, list.summarize, list.recent, dashboard.explain, dashboard.standOut, report.summarize, report.takeaways}`. Each pack is +22/-0 with the same key tree. Neither key path exists on `main`, so nothing collides. No existing key is removed, renamed or changed: the locale hunks have no deleted lines. Nothing on the head iterates `console.ai.suggestions` as an object, so the new `page` child changes the meaning of no existing read. `zh-Hant.ts` keeps its generated header and holds the s2twp form of the `zh-Hans` strings. The greeting reuses the existing `home.greeting*` / `home.greetingSeparator` / `home.greetingEnd` keys (present on `main`, `en.ts:4376-4385`) without changing their meaning.
- **`@object-ui/plugin-chatbot` (published): `ChatbotEnhancedProps.renderEmptyState?: (actions: { send, fill }) => React.ReactNode` (`chat/types.ts`). Named right, and it is a pure widening.** The prop is optional. It is destructured in `ChatbotEnhanced.tsx`, so it is never spread onto the root `div`. Without it, the `messages.length === 0` branch renders the built-in `ConversationEmptyState` exactly as before. `send` is the existing `handleSuggestionClick(text)`. `fill` uses the same prototype-setter-plus-`input`-event route the file already uses to restore rejected composer text (`ChatbotEnhanced.tsx` ~532). `ChatbotEnhancedProps` is already re-exported from `index.tsx:308`, so no export is added or removed.
- **`@object-ui/app-shell` (private): no published surface.** `EmptyConversation.tsx` and `emptyConversationModel.ts` are new. `ChatPane` gains the optional `emptyConversation` prop, and only `ChatDockConversation` passes it (`git grep` shows one caller), so `AiChatPage` and the AI home's conversation state keep the built-in empty state. `ChatDockConversation` maps `presentation: 'full'` to large and anything else to compact. **The `AppAskPage` rewrite narrows nothing:**
  - The module still exports only `AppAskPage` and the default export, on both sides.
  - `AskHome` and `RecentAskConversations` are file-local. Renaming `AskHomeProps.title` to `heading: React.ReactNode` reaches no importer.
  - The page header still reads `console.ai.empty.ask.title` ("Ask your data") as its no-label fallback.
  - One rendering behaviour changes: with no declared `title`, the home heading greets by time of day and name instead of reading "Ask your data". The card's step 3 and the claim's seat ruling cover this, and the changeset body discloses it.
  - The test ids `app-ask-title`, `app-ask-subtitle`, `app-ask-suggestions` and `app-ask-recent*` become `empty-conversation-*`. `git grep` on the head finds no reader of the old ids outside `AppAskPage-37788.test.tsx`, which the PR moves to the new ids. The ids that other tests read (`app-ask-home`, `app-ask-input`, `app-ask-send`, `app-ask-scope`) are kept.
  - `AppAskPage-37788.test.tsx` changes its expectation only for the ruled heading change. The fallback case now matches the greeting pattern instead of "Ask your data". No other assertion is dropped.
- **No narrowing anywhere in the diff.** Nothing published is removed, renamed, tightened or given a new meaning.

### ② Semver level

- The changeset lists `@object-ui/app-shell`, `@object-ui/plugin-chatbot` and `@object-ui/i18n`, each at `patch`. These are the three packages the diff moves. The two published packages are in the `fixed` group in `.changeset/config.json`. `privatePackages.version: true` makes listing the private `app-shell` the house pattern, as many changesets on `main` do. The package list matches what ships.
- `Metadata-protocol: none` is correct: the diff changes no spec, no `AiChatNavParams` and nothing a metadata author can write. Per AGENTS.md (Post-Task Checklist item 3), `none` takes `patch`, so `patch` is the right level, including for the widening.
- The `Clause-②: yes (widening)` line appears word for word in the PR body and in the changeset body. It matches the claim's `Clause-②: yes` and the diff, which is purely additive (see ①). No migration text is owed, and "Nothing to migrate" is right.
- `Check Changeset` and `PR-body guards` are `success` on the head.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **`open_questions`: `[]`.** Nothing to answer.
- **`out_of_scope_findings`: the greeting hour buckets are copied from Home (`carrier: none`). Answered.** `greetingForHour` (`emptyConversationModel.ts`) agrees bucket for bucket with `pickGreetingKey` (`console/home/HomePage.tsx:341-347` on `main`): 5, 12, 18 and 23. Both read the same keys. The duplication is real but harmless today, and not filing it is within the report's discretion.
- **File surface breach: `ui/packages/plugin-chatbot/src/chat/types.ts`. Answered.** Claim amendment 7222366115 records it. It is the single declaration site of the prop named in ①, so it adds no scope. `agentCopy.ts` is claimed but untouched, which is under the claim and fine.
- **Card step 3 says "Greeting … new strings in eleven locales"; the PR adds none for the greeting. Answered.** It reuses Home's existing greeting keys, so the console greets one way everywhere. The per-page suggestions are the new strings, and they are in all eleven packs.
- **Browser check: NOT MEASURED. Answered.** The drawer is inert on an OSS backend, which has no agent catalog. The real-component DOM test (`ChatDock.emptyConversation-37862.test.tsx`, which uses the real `ChatDockConversation`, `ChatPane` and `ChatbotEnhanced`) pins the three sizes, fill versus send and the recent list. `Live E2E UI` is `success` on the head.
- **C4 #37970 draft, with an overlap check clean against `30a8047b`. Answered.** It is a sequencing note with no contract effect.
- **F1 (escalated, not blocking): the accepted deviation that the drawer composer stays docked at the bottom instead of centred in the empty state.** The card's 维护者速读 names a 大输入框 as part of the one shared layout. Its acceptance requires that full-screen and drawer new chats "show the layout". No card step and no ruling on the card exempts the drawer. The only acceptance is the claiming seat's own amendment (7222366115), which this review does not adopt as a ruling. The deviation changes no public surface: `EmptyConversation.composer` is an optional slot, so centring a composer in the drawer later is an additive app-shell change. The stated reason (the docked composer carries the page chip, C5's focus row and queued sends) is concrete. Escalated: the maintainer confirms the deviation against topic #37853's target experience, or orders a follow-up that centres the drawer composer.
- **F2 (nit): SQL push-down check. No SQL push-down finding; the reason is given here.**
  - No query, id materialisation or join is built. `selectDrawerRecent` filters one page of `GET /ai/conversations` in the client. That REST route is served by cloud `service-ai`, with no SQL path in this repo. The filter keeps the drawer agent's alias group and drops rows that carry `metadata.activePackageId`.
  - This is the scoping the drawer history already applies (`ConversationsSidebar.tsx:172-196`, alias group in the client) and the rule the AI home already uses (`recentAskPageConversations`).
  - The nit: `DrawerRecentConversations` fetches an unnamed literal `limit: 20`, while the AI home names its page (`ASK_RECENT_FETCH_LIMIT = 50`). When a user's newest 20 rows are all AI-home or other-agent threads, the drawer draws fewer than three or five rows, or no section, even though older drawer threads exist. It never draws a wrong row. Name the constant, and consider the AI home's page size.
- **Gates.** At review time the head's check-runs read 18 `success`, 13 `skipped`, 25 `in_progress` and 0 failed. Still running are `Type Check UI`, `Test UI` 1-16, `Lint UI`, `Build & E2E UI`, `Type Check · consumer gates` and the `Lint ·` families. Their conclusions, not this record, answer the type and test families. This record judges ①–③ only.

## 席位核对 — L1 @ `b41c6ea0a9ae50397f8ea18a7c4c829446047b5d`

**Verdict: ACCEPT on the code, with one landing condition (D1 below).**

The contract review on this head is PASS at `TIER_DEFAULT` (record 7222493699, brief 7222420291). It is owed only because of the `Clause-②: yes (widening)` declaration, since `record-recognisers --paths` decides no face. It has no must-fix and no should-fix.

### D1 — the full-window new chat keeps the composer at the bottom (landing condition, the maintainer's call)

Topic #37853's target experience, item 9, reads "AI home / full-screen new chat: greeting, big composer, example questions, 「最近会话 · 标题」". The card's 维护者速读 lists 大输入框 as part of the one layout, and its acceptance says full-screen and drawer new chats "show the layout".

At this head:
- The AI home keeps its large question box.
- The drawer, including `presentation === 'full'` (`ChatDockConversation.tsx`, `size: 'large'`), draws the greeting, suggestions and recent conversations above the composer, and leaves the composer where it is at the bottom.

So the full-screen new chat meets item 9 except for the big composer. The claim amendment records this as an accepted deviation, for a real reason: the composer carries the page chip, C5's focus row and the queued sends. But it is the seat's own acceptance against the maintainer's target experience. L2 escalated it as F1.

Either outcome lands the PR as it is, apart from its first line:
- **(a) The maintainer accepts the bottom composer.** `Fixes #37862` stands.
- **(b) The maintainer wants the big composer in the full window.** The first line becomes `Part of #37862`, and a follow-up card carries it.

No code change is asked on this head.

### Checklist

- **Shape and relation.** Draft, base `main`, first line `Fixes #37862`, and no other closing keyword. Blocked-by #37788 and C4 #37860/#37970 have both landed. Every step on the card is in the diff, D1 aside:
  1. One component used three ways. `EmptyConversation` is `large` on the AI home and the full window, and `compact` in the rail and the sheet.
  2. The three overlaps with #37788 are resolved:
     - **Modes.** App suggestions on the AI home send. In the drawer, page suggestions about the record in view fill, and those on list, dashboard and report pages send.
     - **Recent conversations.** On the AI home, a recent conversation opens on the page (`?c=`). In the drawer, it opens in the drawer, filtered to the drawer's agent group and to conversations with no `activePackageId`.
     - **Suggestion source.** On the AI home it is the `ai:chat` params. In the drawer it is the page kind (`pageKindOfSurface`).
  3. The greeting reuses `home.greeting*` with Home's hour boundaries. The per-page suggestions are new strings in 11 locales: 8 `page.*` keys plus `suggestionsLabel`, with `zh-Hant` generated.
  4. Non-`ask` agents and pages with no page kind keep `buildAgentSuggestions`.
- **Scope.** All 23 files are inside the claim (7221234060) and amendment 7222366115 (`plugin-chatbot/src/chat/types.ts`). `agentCopy.ts` is claimed but untouched.
- **Changeset, read sentence by sentence** (`.changeset/37862-empty-conversation.md`). The packages are app-shell, plugin-chatbot and i18n, all at `patch`, which `Metadata-protocol: none` takes. Every sentence is true at this head:
  - the AI home's title, or else the greeting, where it read "Ask your data";
  - "the composer stays where it is, under the conversation";
  - record suggestions fill and the rest send;
  - other assistants keep their starter questions;
  - recent conversations number 3, or 5 in the full window, belong to the drawer's assistant, and open in the drawer;
  - `renderEmptyState` gives `send` and `fill`.
- **`fill` is safe as written.** It sets the textarea through the prototype setter and dispatches `input`, so React's tracker and the host's `onInputChange` both see it, and it sends nothing. The report's ablation using a plain `.value` setter turns a case red.
- **Test and gate evidence.** The os-dev-report (7222350321) gives:
  - at `b41c6ea0`: the four new or changed test files, 35 cases;
  - at `bf9d5b8f`: the wider app-shell, chatbot and i18n runs;
  - `dispatch-gates`: 41/41 with 0 NOT-MEASURED;
  - four ablations red;
  - `overlap-check` clean against #37970, #37924, #37989, #38004 and #38005.

  Check-runs at this head: 45 success, 13 expected skip, 0 failed, 0 pending; `Lint & Repo Gates` and `TypeScript Type Check` green. No dogfood battery is owed.

### Accepted deviations

- **L2 F2 (nit).** The drawer's recent list reads one unnamed `limit: 20` page and filters it in the browser, so a user whose newest 20 conversations belong to other agents sees fewer rows than intended. This is accepted with no head move. A follow-up could name the constant, or ask the list endpoint for the agent.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `TIER_DEFAULT`
Head-sha: `b25938f9705ddcf315fcf2a73f02ded1b84c62b4`
Local-runs: none

This is a delta review on top of the PASS at `b41c6ea0` (record 7222493699). The delta is two commits:
- `775b0594` merges `origin/main` at `4af32b99`, which brings in C4 #37970.
- `b25938f9` takes F2.

I read card #37862's new comments (7222625442 and 7222646032), the current PR body, the net diff `origin/main...b25938f9` (merge base `4af32b99`), `git show b25938f9`, `git show 4af32b99` restricted to the shared files, and the head's check-runs. The diff still touches no `packages/spec`, no skill, no ADR and no other governed path, so the declaration face is the only one owed.

### ① Derived judgments

- **The merge carries C7's diff over unchanged. Verified independently.** The net file list is still 23 files.
  - Sorted, the added and removed lines of `4af32b99..775b0594` are identical to those of `4de4e3e9..b41c6ea0`. Only the context differs, which is why the patch-ids differ.
  - `.changeset/37862-empty-conversation.md` is byte-identical between `b41c6ea0` and `b25938f9`.
  - The net diff against `main` grows only by `b25938f9`'s +9/−1.
- **(a) `DRAWER_RECENT_FETCH_LIMIT` changes nothing public.**
  - It is a new `export const` in `ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/ai/emptyConversationModel.ts`, equal to `ASK_RECENT_FETCH_LIMIT` (50), and `EmptyConversation.tsx` reads it.
  - `@object-ui/app-shell` is `"private": true`. Neither module is re-exported from any package `index`; `git grep` finds only in-package importers, plus comments in the locale packs.
  - The new import `emptyConversationModel.ts` → `appAskPageModel.ts` creates no cycle: `appAskPageModel.ts` imports only `@objectstack/spec/ui` and `hooks/chatScope.js`.
  - The published surface is the same as at `b41c6ea0`: the nine `@object-ui/i18n` keys and the optional `renderEmptyState` prop on `@object-ui/plugin-chatbot`. Both are widenings, and nothing narrows.
- **(b) C4's shared surface composes with C7's empty state. No interaction finding.**
  - **`ChatPane.tsx`:** C4 adds `useAuth` and a per-conversation plan-approval publish that runs only when there is a `conversationId`. C7's `emptyConversation`, `emptySuggestions` and `renderEmptyState` block sits alongside it unchanged. Both read `useAuth` independently, and neither writes state the other reads.
  - **`ChatDockConversation.tsx`:**
    - C4 adds `onShownConversationChange`, the header label (`useConversationLabel`) and the `startNew` action carried through a ref.
    - C7's `emptyConversation` memo passes C4's unchanged `openConversation` as `onOpenConversation`. That is the callback the history sidebar's `onSelectConversation` uses, so opening a recent row reaches the same target change and closes the history panel, exactly as a history row does.
    - C4's new-conversation paths all reach C7's empty state the intended way. A fresh target after the user's own close (`forceNew = target.fresh && !requestedConversationId`) and the header's ＋ (`startNewConversation`, `fresh: true`) both remount the keyed `ChatPane` with no messages, so C7's empty state draws and `DrawerRecentConversations` reads afresh. The thread the user just closed is a drawer-agent row, so it can appear under 「最近会话」.
    - C4's pending-approval reopen restores a conversation that has messages, so the empty state does not draw.
    - With no `paneConversationId`, C4 gives the header no label, and C7's heading greets. The two do not conflict.
  - **`useConversationList.ts`:** C4 only appends `useConversationLabel`, which fetches `/conversations/:id` for a shown conversation. `useConversationList` itself is unchanged and keeps no shared cache, so the drawer list now using the same page size as the AI home and the history (50) shares no state between them.
  - **Locale packs:** C4 rewrites the value of `chatDock.planAwaitingApproval` in all 11 packs. That key is outside C7's lines. C7's `console.ai.suggestions.page.*` and `console.ai.suggestionsLabel` appear once in each of the 11 merged packs, with no duplicate keys.

### ② Semver level

Unchanged from `b41c6ea0`, and still right.
- The changeset is byte-identical: `@object-ui/app-shell`, `@object-ui/plugin-chatbot` and `@object-ui/i18n` at `patch`, with `Metadata-protocol: none`, which takes `patch`.
- `Clause-②: yes (widening)` appears in both the PR body and the changeset.
- The new constant is private to app-shell and adds no level.
- The PR body still reads `Fixes #37862`, which is correct after F1's ruling (see ③).

### ③ Boundary flags

- **(c) F2 (nit) is closed.** `DrawerRecentConversations` now reads `limit: DRAWER_RECENT_FETCH_LIMIT`, which is named and documented as the AI home's page size of 50 (`ASK_RECENT_FETCH_LIMIT`). That fixes the unnamed literal and widens the page the drawer filters, so under-fill is much less likely.
  - The client-side filter over one REST page is unchanged. The no-push-down reason given at `b41c6ea0` still holds: the route is served by cloud `service-ai`, and the scoping matches `ConversationsSidebar`'s.
  - Moving from limit 20 to 50 breaks no pin: the only `limit=50` matcher on the head (`AppAskPage-37788.test.tsx:237`) mounts `AppAskPage` alone, whose `ChatPane` passes no `emptyConversation`.
- **(c) F1 (escalated) is answered.**
  - On #37862, 7222625442 relays Tesla's first tap, 「要做成居中大输入框」 (15:53Z). That ruling split the work into two PRs and confirmed the deviation was real against topic #37853 item 9.
  - 7222646032 relays the retraction within the minute, 「感觉在底部也没问题，不用继续了」 (15:54Z). It states that it supersedes 7222625442: the full-screen composer stays at the bottom, #38011 keeps `Fixes #37862`, and there is no PR 2 and no follow-up card.
  - The newest ruling governs. Both rulings are relayed by the claiming seat with the maintainer's words quoted verbatim and timestamped. This review adopts them as the maintainer's word. The seat's own conclusions were not taken as rulings.
  - The PR body's Acceptance notes now cite 7222646032.
- **Other flags carried from `b41c6ea0`:** the copied greeting rule, the `types.ts` surface breach, the reuse of the greeting keys and the browser check that was not measured. None changes in this delta.
- **`open_questions` and SQL push-down.** `open_questions` is still `[]`. Apart from F2 above, the delta adds no new id materialisation or join.
- **Gates.** At review time the head's check-runs read 12 `success`, 15 `skipped`, 13 `in_progress` and 0 failed. `Check Changeset`, `Live E2E UI`, `Build UI Deps`, the type-check families and the `Lint ·` families were still running, and the `Test UI` shards had not yet appeared. Their conclusions, not this record, answer the derived gate families. This record judges ①–③ only.

### ⛔ merge queue 构建失败 — 先分诊，再决定要不要重排

队列构建 [46038762113](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/actions/runs/46038762113) 红了。队列跑的是**全量**套件（PR 侧 CI 只跑 affected 子集），
